home.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
home.faq.q1.question: What is an image resizer and what does it do?
home.faq.q1.answer: An image resizer is a tool that modifies the pixel dimensions (width and height) or file size of an image. It optimizes photos and graphics for web pages, social media platforms, email attachments, and online portal uploads while maintaining visual clarity.
home.faq.q2.question: How do I resize an image without losing quality?
home.faq.q2.answer: To preserve quality, avoid enlarging smaller images beyond their original dimensions, keep the aspect ratio locked to prevent stretching, and select an optimal output format (such as JPG or WebP) with a quality setting around 80%–90%.
home.faq.q3.question: How can I resize an image to a specific width and height?
home.faq.q3.answer: Upload your image, choose the "Dimensions" mode, and enter your desired pixel width and height. Keep "Lock Aspect Ratio" enabled for proportional scaling, or unlock it to set exact custom dimensions.
home.faq.q4.question: How can I resize an image by percentage?
home.faq.q4.answer: Switch to "Percentage" mode in the tool and choose your preferred scaling factor (such as 50% to halve both width and height, or 75% for moderate reduction). The aspect ratio is preserved automatically.
home.faq.q5.question: How can I reduce an image to a specific KB or MB size?
home.faq.q5.answer: Enter your desired target size in the "Target File Size" field (e.g., 50 KB or 1 MB). ImgFeel uses client-side iterative compression to automatically find the optimal quality level that matches your target file size.
home.faq.q6.question: How can I resize an image to 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, or another specific size?
home.faq.q6.answer: Select JPG or WebP output, enter your required file size limit (such as 20 KB for official documents, 50 KB for portal photos, or 100 KB for web uploads), and ImgFeel will compress the image to fit precisely within that threshold.
home.faq.q7.question: What is the best image format for resizing: JPG, PNG, or WebP?
home.faq.q7.answer: JPG is best for standard photos and small file sizes. PNG is best for graphics, screenshots, and images requiring background transparency. WebP offers the best modern compression, delivering smaller file sizes than JPG and PNG at equivalent visual quality.
home.faq.q8.question: Why does my resized image look blurry or pixelated?
home.faq.q8.answer: Blurriness happens when upscaling a small, low-resolution image to larger dimensions, or when applying overly aggressive compression. For crisp results, always downscale from a high-resolution original image.
home.faq.q9.question: How can I resize an image without stretching or distorting it?
home.faq.q9.answer: Ensure the "Lock Aspect Ratio" checkbox is turned on. When enabled, adjusting the width automatically adjusts the height (and vice versa) in exact proportion to the original photo.
home.faq.q10.question: Why is my image still too large after resizing?
home.faq.q10.answer: An image may remain large if saved in lossless PNG format, if dimensions are still high, or if quality is set to 100%. To reduce file size further, switch the format to JPG or WebP and adjust the quality slider to 75%–85%.
home.faq.q11.question: Can I resize and compress an image at the same time?
home.faq.q11.answer: Yes. ImgFeel allows you to set target pixel dimensions and apply file size compression in a single operation before downloading your optimized image.
home.faq.q12.question: Can I resize images on my phone?
home.faq.q12.answer: Yes. ImgFeel is fully responsive and functions smoothly in mobile browsers on iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android smartphones without requiring any app download.
home.faq.q13.question: Can I resize JPG, PNG, and WebP images online?
home.faq.q13.answer: Yes. ImgFeel supports uploading and resizing all popular web formats, including JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP, and allows converting between them during export.
home.faq.q14.question: Are my images uploaded or stored when I use ImgFeel?
home.faq.q14.answer: No. All image resizing and compression happens 100% locally inside your web browser using HTML5 Canvas technology. Your files are never uploaded to any remote server or stored anywhere.
home.faq.q15.question: Is ImgFeel free and safe to use?
home.faq.q15.answer: Yes. ImgFeel is completely free with no registration, subscriptions, or hidden charges. Because files are processed entirely on your device, your private photos and sensitive documents remain completely confidential.
